about.label: About
paragraphs: I take AI to production inside companies. I sit with executives to find the highest-value workflow, design the integration, orchestrate models and agents with rules that make every result auditable, and measure the return in weeks, not months.

I'm an entrepreneur. I co-founded [aiLearning](https://ailearning.mx), the AI learning platform made in Mexico, run by three people and a team of agents; there, a multi-model pipeline shipped 114 lessons in 2 days. I founded Space Gray MX, a marketplace for certified MacBooks that grew sales 30x in 3 months. And I give talks on how to lead agents.

Before that, at PEMEX headquarters, I turned operational needs into requirements with generative AI and the team cut its workload by 66%. I was a Talent Land ambassador in front of audiences of 2,000+. I'm an IPN graduate and I work in Spanish and English.
